newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AUTOMAKERS TO DELIST FROM S.AFRICA JSE FRI.
newsitem.headline: AUTOMAKERS TO DELIST FROM S.AFRICA JSE FRI.

text.p: Automakers Ltd, a South African motor firm, will be delisted from the Johannesburg Stock Exchange at the end of trade on Friday, the company said.
Nissan Motor Co Ltd of Japan last month bought a 50 percent stake in Automakers from Automakers parent, Sankorp for 360.75 million rand. The deal takes effect on July 1.
In terms of an agreed upon scheme, Automakers' minority shareholders will receive 411 cents a share against the surrender of their share certificates.
